ja275:1.1: Who is the pretty crane living in the crow’s nesting place?
ja275:1.3: Fierce is the crow my friend,
ja275:2.1: Surely you know me, dear friend,
ja275:2.4: after coming, see me being plucked.
ja275:3.1: Again you will suffer, dear friend,
ja275:3.3: The wealth of human beings cannot be enjoyed by birds.
